tags.description: Pigeon Island (Güvercin Ada), Kaş: white marble shark sculpture left from past underwater art exhibitions, an old partly scattered wooden wreck at ~22m, a sheet-metal wreck sunk as an artificial reef at ~28m, and a small ~28m reef with broken amphorae. PADI lists max depth 30m; Nautilus Diving Kaş gives no overall maximum. Sculptor, creation year and sculpture depth could not be verified and have been removed.
tags.name: Shark Sculpture
Uçak Batığı
tags.historic_period: aircraft type dates to WWII; this airframe served with the Turkish Air Force before decommissioning and scuttling in 2008
tags.description: Ex-Turkish Air Force Douglas C-47A Dakota (~19.57m long, ~28.96m wingspan per Zentacle and taucher.net; ~19m/29m per Sualtı Gazetesi), deliberately scuttled by BOSAD as an artificial reef at Karaada/Pacoz Bay near Bodrum on 1 July 2008 (Sualtı Gazetesi, Zentacle, taucher.net, X-Ray Mag; The Divers' Club says 2007). Later broken up/shifted deeper (sources attribute this to a 2010 current, or to slippage in winter 2008/09). Reported depths conflict: 17-32m (Aquapro, X-Ray Mag), 25m (Zentacle), 25-30m (taucher.net), fuselage ~34m (Divers' Club, Sualtı Gazetesi). Not the Savoia-Marchetti SM.79 previously listed.

tags.name: Büyük Resif
tags.description: Big Reef, ~20 min by boat from Bodrum near Karaada (Black Island). Wall facing Karaada drops from ~7m to 34m (Happy Bubbles); The Divers' Club gives summit at 5m and max 34m; The Scuba Tank reports ~50m. Strong currents; dive-shop sources recommend experienced/advanced divers.

tags.name: Aksona
tags.description: Aksona Point beyond Karaada near Bodrum, ~50 min by boat, named for sponge hunter Aksona Mehmet. Starts at ~3m, slopes through the 20s to a rock wall at 30-35m. Single-guide report of a Phoenician ship anchor at ~13.5m and amphorae; another source mentions Ottoman ship wrecks nearby. Skill-level guidance varies between sources (intermediate-and-above to advanced).
